messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: nanoscan3-manual, p. 8

1 ABOUT THIS DOCUMENT 1 About this document 1.1 Scope Product This document applies to the following products: O Product code: nanoScan3 I/O O “Operating instructions” type label entry: 8024594 Document identification Document part number: O This document: 8024596 O Available language versions of this document: 8024594 You can find the current version of all documents at www.sick.com. 1.2 Target groups of these operating instructions Some sections of these operating instructions are intended for certain target groups. However, the entire operating instructions are relevant for intended use of the product.
